evidence.title: DecoVAE: a Lightweight Interpretable Trend-Seasonal VAE Framework for Efficient Probabilistic Time Series Forecasting

summary: DecoVAE is a new variational autoencoder (VAE) framework designed for efficient and interpretable probabilistic forecasting of time series data, combining trend and seasonal components. The model aims to improve accuracy while reducing computational overhead in real-world applications.
title: Researchers Introduce DecoVAE: A Lightweight, Interpretable AI Model for Probabilistic Time Series Forecasting
